title: Analytics ingestion: observability runbooks, SLI onboarding, and dashboard templates
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Background: The console backend emits ~50M usage events/day into the analytics ingestion pipeline. Over the past 6 months we've seen intermittent ingest failures, delayed delivery to downstream stores, and large variance in trace coverage across services. There is inconsistent SLI/SLO coverage: some metrics are defined ad-hoc per-team, dashboards differ in structure, and there are no published runbooks for the most common failure modes. This ticket consolidates observability work for the analytics ingestion path: we will produce operational runbooks for the top failure modes, canonical SLI definitions and onboarding tooling, templated Grafana dashboards, and guidance for trace sampling and log cardinality to control cost.
acceptance_criteria: Runbooks published for top 5 ingestion failure modes (schema mismatch, kafka backpressure, consumer rebalancing, retention GC, downstream write timeout) with step-by-step remediation and postmortem checklist
Canonical SLI definitions committed to the SLO repo (ingest_success_rate, end_to_end_95p_latency, processing_lag_p99) and validated against 90-day baseline
An automated onboarding script (CLI/CI job) that registers an SLI with the SLO service and creates a dashboard from the template
Grafana dashboard templates available with tenant and pipeline variables, plus a promoted ‘analytics-ingest-health’ public dashboard in the console monitoring folder
Tracing guidance documented: sampling policy, tagging conventions (tenant_id, pipeline_stage, message_id), and a cost estimate with recommended retention tiers
Alert rules and runbook links wired into PagerDuty for P1/P2 signals; example alerts tested in staging
Team training session delivered and slides archived in Drive with links in the runbooks
tasks: Inventory existing SLIs and dashboards across teams (output: catalog.csv)
Define canonical SLI YAML schema and put in infra/slo-defs/analytics-ingest.yaml
Implement onboarding script that accepts SLI YAML and calls the SLO API (owner: Liam)
Create 3 Grafana JSON dashboard templates with variables: tenant, cluster, pipeline (owner: UX/Observability)
Write runbooks for each failure mode, including playbook commands and 'if X then Y' decision trees
Standardize trace tags and add instrumentation checklist to the SDK and developer docs
Add automated smoke test in CI that verifies SLI metrics are emitted for a synthetic event
Cost analysis: simulate trace+logs retention scenarios and recommend default sampling/retention
notes: This ticket is focused on the console analytics ingestion path (service names: ingest-api, kafka-consumers, transformer, writer). Instrumentation for query-time analytics (console read queries) is out of scope for now.
We should preserve tenant-level isolation in dashboards; do not expose raw PII in the public dashboards.
Prefer lightweight SLI definitions (success rate + latency) to keep downstream SLO evaluation costs low. Detailed per-feature metrics can be added later as custom evaluations.
